text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Tenno Sho (Spring), Gold City 
emerges victorious over Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross was genuinely frustrated. 
Seeing her like that, Gold City realized 
just how much she herself had been letting 
the voices around her dictate her 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hadn't been listening to the voice in 
her heart. But now, she said, her heart 
was screaming that she purely wanted to 
win races and run even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her run brought tears to her manager's 
eyes. Praising the beauty of seeing her 
truly shine and enjoy herself in the place 
she chose, the manager granted her 
blessing to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Takarazuka Kinen, the final 
leg of the Senior Spring Triple Crown. 
It's time to go show Tamamo Cross who Gold 
City truly is...!
